import sys, json, random, itertools, time, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from validate import validate
worst=0; wseed=None; bad=0; stats={'prepared':0,'denied':0,'other':0}
N=int(sys.argv[1]); seed0=int(sys.argv[2])
for seed in range(seed0, seed0+N):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    n=rng.choice([24,32,40,48])
    nl=min(128, rng.randint(n, 3*n))
    allp=list(itertools.combinations(range(n),2)); rng.shuffle(allp)
    tree=[(i,i+1) for i in range(n-1)]
    rest=[p for p in allp if p not in set(tree)]
    pairs=(tree if rng.random()<0.8 else [])+rest[:max(0,nl-len(tree))]
    links=[[u,v,rng.choice([1,2,3,5,8,20])] for (u,v) in pairs[:128]]
    k=rng.randint(3,12)
    parts=sorted(rng.sample(range(n),k))
    per=rng.choice([1,5,50])
    env=[[l,rng.choice([1,2,3])] for l in rng.sample(range(len(links)), rng.randint(1,min(len(links),8)))]
    dem=[[v,rng.choice([0,1,2,3])] for v in parts]
    if sum(d for _,d in dem)==0: dem[0][1]=1
    cmds=[{"op":"load","n":n,"links":links,"bookings":[]},
          {"op":"prepare","id":"pa","owner":"o","window":[0,per*3],"period":per,
           "participants":dem,"envelope":env,"rev":0}]
    t0=time.time()
    out=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","-B","submission/main.py"],input="\n".join(json.dumps(c) for c in cmds)+"\n",capture_output=True,text=True)
    dt=time.time()-t0
    if dt>worst: worst=dt; wseed=seed
    reps=[json.loads(x) for x in out.stdout.splitlines()]
    problems=[]; validate(cmds,reps,problems)
    r=reps[-1]
    if r.get('status')=='prepared': stats['prepared']+=1
    elif r.get('status')=='denied': stats['denied']+=1
    else: stats['other']+=1
    if problems:
        bad+=1; print("SEED",seed,problems[:3])
print(f"N={N} bad={bad} worst={worst:.1f}s seed={wseed} {stats}")
PYEOF
